summary: John Deere Owner Trust 2026-B filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement (Underwriting Agreement) dated July 14, 2026, in connection with a public offering of asset-backed securities (Notes). The transaction is a routine securitization of equipment loan receivables, not a special situation. The Depositor (John Deere Receivables LLC) and underwriters including BofA Securities, Citigroup, MUFG, RBC, and TD Securities are involved. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation catalyst is present. The filing includes standard certifications and exhibits for an ABS issuance. This is a typical structured finance offering; no event-driven or risk-arb angle applies.
